messages.subject: Code for outlie()
parts:
Greetings ctmm community,

I'm wondering if anyone has a chunk of code that applies the outlie() function for multiple individuals in a loop? Including, applying outlie() multiple times for each individual until outliers are identified and subsequently removed - then, run the next individual through the same process.

I am working with >200 individual collared animals and would like to run all of them through outlie() in a loop.

Thanks!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Code for outlie()
parts:
Hi Ollie,

You would want something vaguely like this:

for(i in 1:length(ANIMAL))
{
  OUT <- outlie(ANIMAL[[i]],plot=FALSE)
  BAD <- OUT$speed > THRESHOLD
  while(BAD)
  {
    ANIMAL[[i]] <- ANIMAL[[i]][!BAD,]
    OUT <- outlie(ANIMAL[[i]],plot=FALSE)
    BAD <- OUT$speed > THRESHOLD
  }
}

Best,
Chris
